summary: The accepted ingredients already provide genuine full-PW vector actions H0, bare ionic g(u), longitudinal spin K, physical Fourier maps, the complete 111-coordinate frozen ionic component, and nonorthogonal physical factor contractions. They do not provide a material coupled propagator merely by being wrapped in callbacks.

The positive next route is a selected-observable covariance-column forward consumer, with a full original-basis trace-dual comparator. Use the declared physical preparation to form selected ordered initial covariance sources; propagate their full-PW ket/bra factors together with all 111 ionic coordinates and K feedback; evaluate the existing force/number probes. This avoids manufacturing an independent random state on redundant orbital amplitudes and avoids requiring every pulled observable to remain a low-rank operator.

The representation has an important fork that must be settled with Scope A: stationary invariant reference support permits a fixed rectangular tangent frame; a consistently evolving prepared mean permits a moving rectangular frame; a fixed nonstationary reference does not permit either closure without its explicit background treatment. A general dyadic-history representation can retain the latter equation without dropping newly generated directions, but its rank grows and no scalable bound is established here.

For arbitrary dual propagation, saved A Psi and A-dagger Psi alone are not closed: the free commutator needs A applied to H0 Psi, and feedback injects local-potential and ionic operators. Full-PW rows in an initial factor archive are not a propagator for those operators. A dynamic operator-expression/adjoint adapter or the selected forward-covariance route is required.

A first useful material result can be one short-lag selected-Gamma ordered correlation between total H32-x force and an initial Ni1-x force probe, with a periodic-number readout and all ionic/electronic/cross contributions separately identified. It is conditional on an explicitly admitted reference and preparation; this report chooses neither state nor temperature. Selected Gamma remains a deliberately partial k/q calculation, not a coherence domain.

Actual receipts support bounded work-unit planning, not a runtime promise for time evolution. The largest unresolved implementation costs are all-111-coordinate force contraction, time-stepping workspace, reference-frame closure, and possible dyadic rank growth. All are named implementation/oracle obligations rather than reasons to rerun accepted physics.

findings.finding: H0, K and g are actual actions, not only projected matrices. H0 can act on arbitrary vectors in the original finite-PW rows; g can prepare an arbitrary full nat-by-3 Gamma direction and act on arbitrary 1..16-column blocks. K acts on full physical complex up/down grid envelopes.
findings.consequence: Reuse the action implementations and their bound inputs. Do not rebuild dense PW-square H0 or reinterpret projected_h0_ry as a complete Hamiltonian.

findings.finding: Neither existing dynamics class is a drop-in actual-material consumer. FermionChannel requires square orbitals/H0 and stationary rho0; PhysicalObservableTransfer stores d-by-d probes. PWElectronicDynamics requires complete target eigenvectors and source energies and hardcodes six ionic coordinates; PWCoupledDynamics requires 6-by-6 curvature and six masses.
findings.consequence: A new representation-specific full-PW material adapter is required. Replacing h0 with a callable inside these constructors would leave their actual state, force, density, rank and preparation contracts unsatisfied.

findings.finding: The physical factor contraction already retains the empty finite-PW complement without constructing a PW-square covariance. A selected fixed-right-probe covariance source can prospectively be factored and advanced by the forward EOM, rather than evolving the entire pulled operator.
findings.inference_boundary: The covariance-source transformation and its rectangular coupled evolution are new adapter/oracle subjects, not identities established by this investigation. They must reproduce the already implemented CAR ordered trace for both orderings, including ionic/cross pieces.

findings.finding: A saved-factor frame is not automatically invariant under the accepted output-density H0. Therefore a fixed rectangular orbital tangent cannot silently use the saved eigenvalue labels for its right action. Stationary-support closure, a consistently moving mean frame, or an explicit growing dyadic history is required.
findings.consequence: Accept the existing raw residual diagnostics. Do not add a residual gate, repair vectors, invent a temperature or redo the source physics. Scope A supplies the background interpretation; a new independent small comparison supplies the closure proof.

findings.finding: A Psi and A-dagger Psi do not specify the action of an arbitrary pulled A on the new vectors needed by the commutator. Furthermore the force and density feedback terms inject primitive g and local multiplication operators, which need not be low rank. Low rank of the preparation does not imply low rank of the evolving probe.
findings.consequence: Retain a true operator/adjoint expression representation with growing support if arbitrary dual pullback is pursued. For the first selected C(t,0), prefer forward covariance columns and keep the dense dual as an independent small-space comparator. Neither route is declared scalable without its new work-unit evidence.

findings.finding: The full EOM and CAR preparation retain diagonal/equal-population sectors; the unitary-orbit energy and classical tangent covariance intentionally do not. Nonorthogonal D entries are not probabilities. The identity in I-rho is the complete finite-PW identity, not an identity on saved bands and not I-Psi Psi-dagger.
findings.consequence: No f_i-f_j inversion, population cutoff, null-sector deletion or independent random delta-psi amplitudes in the material transfer adapter.

findings.finding: The two archived probe directions do not constitute the full ionic feedback needed by a 111-coordinate coupled trajectory. GammaIonicAction can generate all directions, but repeating a complete g_a action 111 times per RHS is not the only source-supported implementation. Native local-force and nonlocal-force code demonstrate reductions through one density transform and shared beta/derivative-beta overlaps.
findings.consequence: Implement an all-coordinate bilinear gradient contraction reusing local and projector intermediates. Use the existing directional action as its small comparison route. Do not copy Native DBLE/real-part, factor-two or final symvector operations blindly: arbitrary complex ordered covariance columns need the complex-linear bilinear contraction and both derivative sides. New force-source bytes require Root closure.

findings.finding: Material H0 uses Fourier transforms whose inverse reconstructs amplitudes; NumberProbeGrid uses a unitary transform with volume cancellation for integrated number. K inputs are physical density in bohr^-3, not integrated number. PhysicalRhoFFT.pair is sesquilinear, whereas the observable dual is bilinear with no conjugation.
findings.consequence: Implement explicit dyad-to-density and potential-to-PW maps with the correct volume and spin/k weights. Register and compare the bilinear transpose map independently; a conjugate adjoint routine is not automatically the trace dual.

findings.finding: FactorPreparation only describes an authorized quasifree electronic state with explicitly empty initial orthogonal complement. It supplies neither an ionic state nor a joint state. An initially electronic observable can develop ionic coefficients under coupled pullback. A missing ionic or cross state must remain missing, not zero by default.
findings.consequence: Require explicit electronic, ionic and joint/cross authority for a TOTAL prepared transfer result. A declared product preparation can have zero cross, but the declaration is a physical input, not a software fallback.

findings.finding: Actual source access now covers all20 WFC files, but this is not a decoded/unfolded complete BvK reference. The current physical material outputs are selected k=q=Gamma, both spins, and two force directions plus periodic number probes. Kq support alone supplies neither non-Gamma ionic actions nor a complete ionic force lattice.
findings.consequence: Publish coverage exactly. Preserve the existing chosen4x4x4 normalization as a partial Gamma-sector convention unless a different finite-system model is explicitly authorized; do not pass a two-channel material slice to UniformModeIndex as though it contained the complete4x4x4 grid.

findings.finding: DOP853 is implemented and used in the finite/fixture route, but the actual implementation allocates sixteen state-sized stage slots, with additional working arrays and possible dense-output actions. A fixed-size array solver cannot consume a variable-rank dyadic representation merely through a callback.
findings.consequence: Before choosing a production stepper, establish fixed rectangular closure or a rank-aware operator algebra, account for all stage storage, and budget actual H0/g/K calls. Qian supplies a genuine matrix-free implicit vector-propagation precedent, but not a proof for this coupled material tangent.

findings.finding: Qian's published fixed-ion algorithm section uses matrix-free implicit solves and discusses predictor-corrector density updates; it explicitly defers moving-ion USPP integration and its error estimates. Giustino's bare/dressed discussion explicitly labels static-vertex approximations and infinitesimal eta.
findings.consequence: Do not import USPP moving-gauge terms into ordinary NC without derivation, describe the published fixed-ion method as an already-proven coupled-material integrator, replace bare g with a screened vertex, or infer physical damping from a numerical eta/window.

representation_contract.source_equation_to_reproduce: The implemented finite reference at C01:181-197 is d(delta_rho)/dt=-i([H0,delta_rho]+[g*u+V(K*n),rho0]), du/dt=p/M, dp/dt=-Cfrozen*u-gradient. C02:72-93 is its bilinear trace dual. These are cited existing equations; the material representation proof is future work.
representation_contract.recommended_first_readout_route: For one fixed initial right probe B, construct the ordered initial covariance of every retained physical coordinate with B using the existing CAR/ionic/cross rules, keep it as a coupled source, and evolve it with the forward linearized action. Evaluate A at requested times. Construct the reverse ordering independently. This targets C_AB(t,0) and C_BA(0,t), not an assumed stationary function of t-s and not a full covariance matrix.
representation_contract.why_full_PW_complement_survives: Electronic source dyads retain npw rows on both ket/bra legs. Their actions can leave the saved-factor span. The complement factor is I-rho in the full finite-PW basis, with the initially empty-complement prescription belonging only to the declared preparation. No projection back to346 saved bands is permitted after H0, g or potential actions.
representation_contract.stationary_support_option: If Scope A establishes a stationary finite-rank reference with invariant factor support, use full-PW rectangular ket/bra tangent blocks around that support, with their small internal frame action explicitly supplied. Retain population/equal-occupation blocks in initial covariance sources. This option is not established for the raw saved Psi by the accepted eigenpair diagnostics.
representation_contract.evolving_prepared_mean_option: If Scope A supplies a consistently evolving prepared mean, propagate its full-PW factor frame and independently represented ket/bra perturbation legs. Preserve D and the frame/gauge meaning consistently, including the initial population block. Qian's fixed occupation labels on moving orbitals are source support for the mean representation, not a proof of this coupled tangent or its two-time statistics. The new rectangular tangent equations and ordered-source map require the small original-basis oracle before material use.
representation_contract.general_held_nonstationary_option: If the chosen held background has non-invariant reference support, use sums of full-PW dyads and append the H0/source-generated legs or a retained source-history representation. Do not assert fixed rank. An exact algebraic change of factor coordinates is distinct from tolerance-based rank compression; any compression would be a separately registered approximation with an observable error obligation. No such compression is selected here.
representation_contract.population_policy: Never derive the initial physical covariance by dividing by f_i-f_j or by using tangent_basis/prepared_covariance. The ordered CAR source includes fractional diagonal noise and degenerate/equal-population coherences. Empty-complement population noise can vanish because the chosen state is empty there, but complement transitions remain and cannot be dropped. Nonempty complement preparation requires additional authorized factors or a different full-state representation;346 saved bands do not specify it.
representation_contract.dual_growth: The free dual i[H0,A] requires action of A on H0-transformed source vectors, not just stored A Psi. Coupling adds -weight*p_probe*g and density feedback operators. Repeated pullback can enlarge the generated vector support and the operator-expression sum; even an initially low-rank A need not stay in a fixed low-rank sum under feedback. Pure free unitary conjugation and coupled injected sums must not be conflated.
representation_contract.two_time_extension: A first C(t,0) does not establish arbitrary C(t,s). For nonzero s, either a validated true dual pullback on both probes, a two-sided covariance-source evolution, or a correctly conditioned forward construction is required. Report that capability separately; never replace C(t,s) by C(t-s,0) without stationarity authority.
representation_contract.finite_oracle_role: Keep original-basis matrices and the existing dense dual for tiny independent comparators. Do not deploy their d^2 probe storage, d^4 all-covariance objects or complete PW eigensolves on the actual material as a disguised callback solution.

propagation_contract.supported_facts: C36-C38 provide an actual array-based explicit ODE implementation; C33 provides published matrix-free implicit vector propagation. Neither source proves feasibility of the new material coupled representation.
recommended_engineering_order: First settle reference/frame closure and implement the actual coupled action plus physical covariance-source/readout adapters.
Use the small complete original-basis comparator to check the representation and finite-time method independently, including a nonstationary-frame case if that is the admitted background.

Use a bounded matrix-free implicit/midpoint-style vector route as a candidate when explicit stage storage or kinetic stiffness is limiting; derive its coupling and adjoint treatment prospectively, rather than assume Qian's fixed-ion method solves the coupled problem.

DOP853 remains a concrete finite-reference/rectangular-fixed-layout option only after its full stage-memory and action-count budget fits. It is not the default material choice merely because solve_ivp already exists.

For any variable-rank route, supply rank-aware addition, H-left/right actions, potential/force contractions and an explicit rank/work stop policy. scipy.solve_ivp cannot directly accept a changing-length state.
unverified_alternatives: Crank-Nicolson/predictor-corrector extension to the new coupled rectangular action is proposed, not implemented or proven here.

A generic LinearOperator/expm_multiply or Krylov label does not solve operator-space storage, trace-dual semantics, initial preparation or rank closure. No such package was located as an existing material propagator.
No fixed low-rank bound for arbitrary dual operators, no low-rank truncation theorem and no actual material time-step/tolerance adequacy has been established.
No USPP moving-ion gauge term, exact interacting evolution, thermal FDT, physical loss or long-time stability claim is imported from the primary propagation sources.
